name: airo-doffy-wrm_claude-select-c12-bs32
description: WRM_claude official 100/25 architecture-selection run, batch size 32, W&B, and HF upload

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_wrm_competition_select_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-wrm-competition-select.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
